name: Continuous beta law
variables: a,b>0 shape parameters; Γ gamma function; x continuous proportion
assumptions: Support endpoints fixed and no point masses at 0 or 1
limitations: Exact-zero or exact-one proportions require an observation or boundary-mass model
failure_conditions: Exact-zero or exact-one proportions require an observation or boundary-mass model
computation: O(1) log density after caching the log beta normalizer
application: Model uncertainty for a latent completion rate before an event
required_inputs: Prior hyperparameters or historical continuous proportions strictly between zero and one, with cutoff timestamps.
data_rights: Use synthetic inputs or source-authorized historical records. Verify licence before acquisition.
incompatible_methods: Inputs first available after the forecast cutoff

name: Symmetric generalized normal residual law
definition: For z=(x−μ)/s, f(x)=p exp(−|z|^p)/(2sΓ(1/p)) on ℝ.
variables: μ location, s>0 scale, p>0 shape, Γ gamma function
assumptions: Residuals are conditionally symmetric with a common shape
limitations: The law cannot represent one-sided heavy tails and p<1 gives a nonconvex location loss
failure_conditions: The law cannot represent one-sided heavy tails and p<1 gives a nonconvex location loss
computation: O(1) log density after caching the shape term
application: Fit symmetric continuous margin errors with shape learned from earlier observations
required_inputs: Historical continuous margin residuals in common units, or synthetic draws.
data_rights: Use synthetic inputs or source-authorized historical records. Verify licence before acquisition.
incompatible_methods: Inputs first available after the forecast cutoff

name: Skew-normal residual law
variables: φ and Φ standard normal density and CDF; μ location; s>0 scale; a real skew parameter
assumptions: Residuals are continuous with a stable asymmetric shape
limitations: The shape parameter has limited attainable standardized skewness and retains light tails
failure_conditions: The shape parameter has limited attainable standardized skewness and retains light tails
computation: O(1) log density using stable normal log CDF evaluation
application: Model asymmetric residuals in a pre-event continuous performance baseline
required_inputs: Historical baseline residuals or simulated continuous measurements.
data_rights: Use synthetic inputs or source-authorized historical records. Verify licence before acquisition.
incompatible_methods: Inputs first available after the forecast cutoff

name: Normal inverse Gaussian residual law
definition: For z=(x−μ)/s and r=√(1+z²), f(x)=a K₁(ar) exp(√(a²−b²)+bz)/(πsr) on ℝ.
variables: a>0, |b|<a; μ location; s>0 scale; K₁ modified Bessel function of the second kind of order one
assumptions: Residuals are continuous and a shared shape describes the fitting population
limitations: Small samples can leave shape weakly identified and the Bessel term needs scaled evaluation in the tails
failure_conditions: Small samples can leave shape weakly identified and the Bessel term needs scaled evaluation in the tails
computation: One Bessel evaluation per density value
application: Fit continuous margin errors with asymmetric exponential tail rates
required_inputs: Historical score-margin residuals from a predeclared model or synthetic errors.
data_rights: Use synthetic inputs or source-authorized historical records. Verify licence before acquisition.
